name: first_install
prompt: 把我当前 Codex pet 刷到 M5Stack Dial 上，并用蓝牙同步任务。
expected_behavior: Use pet2dial. Run doctor, initialize the project, set up dependencies, convert the selected Codex pet, build, upload, run bridge, and verify.

name: refresh_pet
prompt: 我刚在 Codex 里换了宠物，把 Dial 也刷新成新的。
expected_behavior: Use pet2dial. Convert the currently selected Codex pet, rebuild and upload firmware, then run or restart the BLE bridge.

name: install_background_bridge
prompt: 让 Dial 以后开机和 Mac 登录后都自动同步，不要让我挂一个终端。
expected_behavior: Use pet2dial. Treat the bridge as a macOS device service, ensure the project venv and dependencies, install the LaunchAgent with install-autostart, then use status and logs to verify service health.

name: pin_specific_pet
prompt: 不要用当前 auto 选中的宠物，把本机已有的某个指定 pet id 刷进去。
expected_behavior: Use pet2dial with an explicit --pet <pet-id> value supplied by the user or discovered from the local Codex pets directory. Do not hard-code previous-run pet ids; verify that the local Codex pet package exists before conversion.

name: near_miss_arbitrary_image
prompt: 我有一张 PNG，帮我直接刷到 Dial 当宠物。
expected_behavior: Do not use pet2dial as the image-generation path. Explain that pet2dial expects an existing Codex-compatible pet package; create or install the Codex pet first.

name: codex_upgrade_check
prompt: Codex 升级了，帮我看看 pet2dial 依赖的宠物和任务状态有没有漂移。
expected_behavior: Use pet2dial. Read references/codex-compatibility.md, run codex-compat, compare the local snapshot, and explain any app version, atlas geometry, selected pet, or rollout event drift without committing local diagnostic state.
